title: Checking the type before matching
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::util::Tree
output application/json
---
{name: "Alice", email: "alice@example.com", age: 30} mapLeafValues ((v, p) -> if ((v is String) and contains(v, '@')) 'REDACTED' else v)

solution:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::util::Tree
output application/json
---
{name: "Alice", email: "alice@example.com", age: 30} mapLeafValues ((v, p) -> if ((v is String) and contains(v, '@')) 'REDACTED' else v)

explanation.approach: `age` reaches the callback too — every leaf does — but it is not a String, so the `is String` check keeps it as the number `30`, not `"30"`.
